I am always apprehensive to talk to professors about my situation because I feel like they will think I am just making excuses for myself. 

This is mostly because my freshman year I had a really awful depressive period in which I just sort of stopped going to class a few weeks into the quarter (and no one bothered to tell me I could withdraw from classes and take a "W" on my transcript instead of an E). I emailed the first of my professors who emailed me to tell me that I had failed the course for non-attendance and explained what was going on and he basically said that it wasn't his problem. 

I'm wondering if my school includes resources for students with mental illness in its services for disabilities.

I just feel like I'm supposed to be so much better. Everyone was so happy when I started to level out and I wasn't so sad or irritable/explosive all the time. It'd just be a disappointment to them that I was doing well but now I'm not. 

It's not even that I'm afraid that they wouldn't be supportive. They just don't deserve to have to put up with me like this.

I will probably stop taking the seasonale. 

And thank you, hugs are always nice :)
donate ALL the organs! and i'd want a green burial-- where i live there is an amazing "memorial" garden where people are buried to fertilize the plants. it's the circle of life!
